subject: dsa
title: Rotate Image
summary: Rotate an n by n matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place by transposing it and then reversing each row.
problem: Given an n by n matrix, rotate it 90 degrees clockwise in place. Do not allocate a second matrix.

steps.caption: Goal: rotate this matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place. Trick: transpose it, then reverse each row.
Transpose: swap cell (i,j) with (j,i). The diagonal stays put.
Now reverse each row left to right. That completes the clockwise turn.
Done. The matrix is rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
